subject: Model mix & pricing follow-up: token volumes, budget, and $/1M target
messages:

Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Model mix & pricing follow-up: token volumes, budget, and $/1M target

Hi Amelia / Sam —

Thanks again for the time today — good discussion. Quick recap + a couple of clarifying questions so we can size the proposal: 

1) Model mix we discussed: chat (user-facing conversational UI), embeddings (semantic search / recommendations), and a small rerank pipeline for results tuning.
2) You mentioned approximate monthly users and event volumes; can you confirm expected monthly request volumes per model type (ballpark is fine):
   - Chat (conversational prompts / responses): __tokens/month?__
   - Embeddings (short text inputs): __embedding calls/month?__ (we typically convert to token-equivalent for pricing)
   - Rerank (batch scoring): __documents scored/month?__
3) Target unit economics: you said target spend of ~$X–Yk/month and asked for cost per 1M tokens target. For initial sizing, please confirm a target $/1M tokens and a monthly budget range.

Next steps: if you can reply with approximate volumes and target $/1M, we’ll run a quick unit-economics calc and share a 1-page pricing summary + recommended model variants (quantized vs full-precision) and any caching/batching suggestions. I’ve attached a simple token estimation worksheet you can edit.

Attachments: BrightLayer_token_estimates.xlsx (editable)

Thanks —
Marissa

From: Amelia Carter <amelia.carter@brightlayer.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 08 Mar 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Model mix & pricing follow-up: token volumes, budget, and $/1M target

Thanks Marissa — great summary. Answers below inline.

- Chat: ~120M tokens/month (our primary product chat flow, includes system+user+assistant tokens).
- Embeddings: ~600k calls/month; average 40 tokens/input -> ~24M tokens equivalent/month.
- Rerank: batch job runs nightly scoring ~1.2M documents/month; average prompt+context ~15 tokens -> ~18M tokens/month.

Total approximate token load = ~162M tokens/month.

Budget: we have a target monthly budget in the $8k–$12k range for inference across these workloads while we validate the feature. Target cost target: ideally ~$40–60 per 1M tokens (we recognize this varies by model/precision).

A couple of asks:
- Can you show separate line items for chat vs embeddings vs rerank (unit $/1M and estimated monthly spend per model)?
- Any suggestions on splitting chat across a higher-capacity model for critical flows vs a lower-cost variant for non-critical messages?

Happy to hop on a quick 20-min call tomorrow if needed.

—Amelia
Amelia Carter | Head of Product, BrightLayer
amelia.carter@brightlayer.io | +1 617-555-0123

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Amelia Carter <amelia.carter@brightlayer.io>, Sam Lopez <slopez@brightlayer.io>
Cc: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 09 Mar 2027 08:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Model mix & pricing follow-up: token volumes, budget, and $/1M target

Great — thanks for the detail, Amelia. I ran quick unit-economics using your numbers; see summary below (we’ll attach the filled spreadsheet too):

- Estimated monthly tokens: 162M tokens total (chat 120M | embeddings 24M | rerank 18M)
- Suggested model variants:
   * Chat: r-instruct-large-v2 (primary) for critical flows; r-instruct-medium for lower-cost fallbacks.
   * Embeddings: r-embed-lite for bulk vectors (lower precision quantized)
   * Rerank: r-rank-small (optimized for batch scoring; quantized)
- Representative unit costs (examples; exact pricing depends on commitment & Dedicated options):
   * r-instruct-large-v2 (chat): $75 / 1M tokens (FP16)
   * r-instruct-medium (chat fallback): $28 / 1M tokens (Q4 quantized)
   * r-embed-lite (embeddings): $18 / 1M tokens (per-token equivalent)
   * r-rank-small (rerank batch): $22 / 1M tokens

Estimated monthly spend (ballpark):
- Chat (120M) at mix 80% large / 20% fallback = (96M * $75 + 24M * $28) / 1M = $7,200 + $672 = $7,872
- Embeddings (24M) = 24 * $18 = $432
- Rerank (18M) = 18 * $22 = $396

Total estimated spend = ~$8,700 / month (falls inside your $8k–$12k target). If you shift more chat volume to the fallback model, unit economics improve; if you require more high-quality responses, cost increases.

Next steps:
1) Confirm the proposed chat split (80/20) or tell us preferred split.
2) If comfortable, we can put together a short Dedicated-capacity estimate which typically reduces per-token costs by ~15–30% depending on commit.
3) Nikhil (cc’d) will share a one-pager with the price calc and a preliminary mutual action plan (timelines + procurement items).

If you want to quick-call, I’m free 10:30–11:30 PT today.

Thanks —
Marissa

From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Re: Model mix & pricing follow-up: token volumes, budget, and $/1M target

Hi Amelia / Team —

Adding our small pricing/ops note and attaching the filled estimate + a preliminary MA plan. See attachment for the editable per-model calc. A few clarifications:
- We treated embedding calls as token-equivalent using your average tokens/input (40). If your embedding inputs are longer, that will bump costs proportionally.
- For rerank, we assumed nightly batches and no heavy context; if you plan frequent re-ranking on large contexts we should re-run sizing.
- If you want a lower starting point, we can propose a 90/10 chat split (90% fallback) for PoC which would bring the monthly estimate closer to $4.5k–$5.5k.

Attachments: BrightLayer_token_estimates.xlsx, RDW_prelim_ma_plan.pdf

Happy to set up a short procurement checklist call with our sales ops — what times work for you this week?

Best,
Nikhil Sharma | Pricing Ops, Redwood Inference
